description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderRequest" name="Product reorder request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check if product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProduct" name="Wait for product arrival" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Delay" name="More than 10 days waiting" attachedToRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Delay">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded" name="Penalty demanded"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeProductPaths" name=""/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check if whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_OrderNotReady"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name=""/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name=""/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Read" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Read_Check" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_GatewayStock" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">firstProductInStock = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_MergeProductPaths"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Receive" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Register" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_MergeProductPaths"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeProductPaths" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderReadyForShipment = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Courier" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Pack" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Courier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pack_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_Penalty" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Delay" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_End" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder request" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Penalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
